text:
Prateek: kicking off canary for rwd-ft-3b-v2-q4_0 (NF4) — starting 1% traffic to validate quality/latency/cost. Plan: 1% -> 6% -> 25% with 30m windows. Gating: p95 latency, token_cost_pct, hallucination (NLP eval), RougeL/EM on smoke set.

Lucy: @Prateek paste smoke set and exact thresholds? need to confirm hallucination def and slices (safety / legal / codegen).

Prateek: smoke_set ~1.25k prompts: 58% convo, 22% factual, 12% codegen, 8% safety/legal. thresholds:
```
hallu_baseline = 0.0115
max_abs_increase = 0.0035
p95_latency_baseline = 200ms
p95_latency_limit = 320ms
token_cost_pct_increase_limit = +15%
```
Two consecutive windows breaching any primary metric -> auto-fallback to prod-3b.

Devon: add sensitive_faqs slice with stricter hallu cap (0.0015). Also run live shadow-compare on first 10k requests for semantic-similarity distribution (cosine).

Sam: propose weighted-impact trigger. Low-volume latency blips shouldn't rollback. Suggest:
```
score = 0.55*hallu_delta_norm + 0.35*latency_delta_norm + 0.1*cost_delta_norm
fallback if (score > 1.15 AND volume > 1200) OR safety_slice_hallu_delta > 0.0015
```
Also add a fast-circuit: if safety slice fails twice in 10m -> immediate 30s circuit trip followed by rollback.

Prateek: agreed. updating routing rule now.

Infra-bot: deploy started: rwd-ft-3b-v2-q4_0 -> cluster ded-pool-5, canary=1%

Maria: note — q4 kernels adjust KV cache memory layout; monitor 'kv_cache_miss_rate' and 'cold_prefix_latency'. small-batch tail might rise.

Oliver: add regulatory sentinel (reg_docs slice). If any generation matches /SSN|DOB|PII/ regex with confidence < 0.6 -> immediate rollback + page on-call.

QA-bot: pre-canary smoke results: Rouge-L delta = -0.4, EM delta = -0.2, hallucination +0.0012, p95 latency +20ms. All within proposed tolerances.

Lucy: run focused contrastive eval on 500 legal+code prompts before bumping to 6%.

Prateek: starting contrastive batch; enabling token-level cost attribution per route so we can see which endpoints cause cost jumps.

Devon: pin reranker on /codegen endpoints to prod-3b for now to avoid compound noise.

Sam: I'll push weighted-score enforcement into traffic router and enable the rapid fallback circuit. Also add a 2x stricter hysteresis for promotion to 25%.

Infra-bot: shadow logs: https://logs.redwood.internal/canary/1749992020/rwd-ft-3b-v2-q4_0

Prateek: hold at 1% until contrastive eval done + 90m live shadow compare. If clean -> 6% for 2h re-eval -> then staged 25% for 24h. Comments?

Maria: dash updated with kv-cache and cold-prefix charts.

Oliver: compliance alert wired to paging.

Lucy: checklist @Prateek: smoke CSV, contrastive eval report, weighted-rule JSON, reranker pin, sentinel regex list, infra rollback runbook.

Prateek: will post artifacts here when ready. :thumbsup:
